finding.name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
finding.summary: The handler allowlists MultipartFile.getContentType() against image/png and image/jpeg but never sniffs the actual file bytes (no Apache Tika detect, no manual signature check), so a client can send arbitrary file bytes with a forged Content-Type header and pass the check; the stored filename itself is generated safely from UUID.randomUUID() with the extension taken from a fixed map keyed by the same unverified content type.
